description: Two large buttons, each sending a pulse or holding a gate, and each passing a signal through while it is held. The menu sets each button to pulse or to gate

inputs.text: A pulse here counts as that button being pressed
A signal passed through to the output on that row while that button is held and its mode is gate

outputs.text: Sends a pulse when that button is pressed
Sends +10V while that button is held and its mode is gate
Carries the signal patched into that row while that button is held and its mode is gate, and nothing while it is not

notes: pressing a large button sends a pulse from the pulse output on its row
with a button set to gate, holding it down holds +10V at the gate output on its row and passes that row's input through to its output
menu: BUTTON 1 AS GATE and BUTTON 2 AS GATE — set that button to hold a gate while it is held down; with the item off the button sends a pulse instead
